description.text: Teaching Objectives In order to implement the idea of school , and develop “the theoretical basis is strong , the practical ability is stable, the ideological style is simple”, someone who has creating spirit and consciousness for the target, outstanding the character of architecture major, in order to give the majority to the architecture class, some relevant architecture theory as the major class, match with some relevant subject knowledge, focus on the practice teaching and the education of architecture technology. Developing advanced technology talents that meet the needs of socialist modernization; develop in moral, intellectually and physically, and obtain the basis skill of architect as well as doing architectural design,city design, the residential district planning and design, interior design and other research, teaching and managementrelevant subjects. Have the ability of scientific search;Have the ability of design and adapted to work. Duration The basis length of schooling is five years and carry out the flexible schooling system four-seven years. Main Courses Building Construction ONE, History of Foreign Architecture, Basis of Architectural Design, History of Chinese Architecture, Public Architectural Design Principles,Architectural Design SIX, Principle of Residential Building Design,Preliminary Design, Architectural Design ONE, Architectural Design TWO, Architectural DesignTHREE, Architectural DesignFIVE, Principle of Urban Design, Urban Design A, Planning and Design of Residential Area, Architectural Design FOUR, Site Design Principles, Principles of Urban Planning. Click there for detailed information about the courses: Training programs for the Architecture Degree awarded Bachelorof Architecture

duration.text: The Architecture at Jilin Jianzhu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 6. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
